explanation_short: KNN significantly outperforms other models, achieving the best balance of high R2 (0.8172) and low RMSE (0.1132) compared to RF, XGBoost, SVM, and DT.
explanation_full: At the L2L3 level, the analysis confirms KNN's robust performance. Its R2 score of 0.8172 and RMSE of 0.1132 are notably better than the next best model, RF (R2=0.7756, RMSE=0.1254). The difference in performance metrics across all models—from KNN to DT—highlights that KNN provides the most reliable prediction, minimizing both the overall error (RMSE) and maximizing the explained variance (R2) when compared against the other benchmark algorithms.
